svg.title: Trending pipeline with APIs
svg.text: STEP 1 — Collect Posts (15 min · 1 hr · 24 hr)
Pull posts + external signals from 4 sources
Example post pulled: "कोहली का शतक! क्या मैच था!" #IndVsAus · 5,200 likes · 1,340 comments · 87,000 views
Google Trends: "Virat Kohli" +420% in Lucknow · Facebook: 18,000 shares on Times of India page
Filter inappropriate content, exact duplicates, bot spam
Delete: Violence posts, same post copied 500×, bot spam · Keep: Real posts from real users only
STEP 3 — Find What People Are Talking About
Identify topics in 5 categories: People · Events · Movies · Festivals · Politics
Found → Person: विराट कोहली · Event: भारत vs ऑस्ट्रेलिया मैच · Category: क्रिकेट
Merge different ways of saying the same thing into one cluster
Calculate a score for every topic cluster and pick the highest 10
Score = # Unique Users × Likes × Comments × Views × Search Volume
15,000 users × 50,000 likes × 12,000 comments × 200,000 views × 420 search score
STEP 6 — Create One Clean Display Name
Pick the best name; verify spelling; auto-generate hashtag if needed
Messy: "कोहली 100" · "विराट vs aus" → Clean: "विराट कोहली शतक ऑस्ट्रेलिया के खिलाफ" #ViratKohli100
STEP 7 — Add Category · Heat Score · Reason
0.75 × Internal Signals (posts, likes, comments, views from ShareChat)
+ 0.25 × External Signals (Google Trends + Facebook + Hindi News)
"कोहली ने आज सिडनी में शतक लगाया"
